title: Durability SMP Plugin
description: A durability currency that is regulated by death and killing which effect armour and tool durability
body:
# Durability SMP Plugin
👾 When you join for the first time you start with 150 durability on all tools and armour.
Durability doesn't affect wood tools or leather armour.

## Tokens
Every kill gives you a token to add 50 durability to tools or armour. 👍
You can also craft tokens. 

## Deaths
Every death removes 50 durability.
If you have 0 durability, you won't lose more or give rewards.

## Punishments
At 0 durability you can only use leather armour and wood tools.

## Commands:
- /durability check | See your current durability.
- /durability withdraw | Withdraw 50 durability. 
- /durability info | Show plugin info. 
### Admin:
- /durability admin hardreset | Wipes ALL durability data for everyone. | Hidden from auto complete in game for kinda obvious reasons
- /durability admin <player> set <amount> | Sets a player's durability to a specific number.
- /durability admin <player> add <amount> | Adds durability to a player.
- /durability admin <player> remove <amount> | Removes durability from a player.
- /durability admin <player> reset | Resets a player back to the starting durability (150 by default).
- /durability stealer — Generate a Durability Stealer. **Experimental not finsished and probably wont be finsished have fun its a bit broken**

## Notes Important: 
- Tools have a 3.5x durability modifier. Configurable
- Max durability is 600. At max, kills drop tokens at the enemy's location. Configurable
- You can change the token craft and it has a default 
- All changes must be done in config and then you must restart or stop and start you server to initiate them
